results.question: Where should I upload age-verification documents?

messages.text:
Do not upload identity or age-verification documents in this chat; use the official membership portal.

For USA Fencing membership or tournament registration, age-verification documents must be uploaded directly through the official portal:

Sign in at https://member.usafencing.org
Open the user menu and select Edit Profile
Go to the Age Verification section
Follow the portal's document-upload and verification workflow

This process is described in the source: "How to complete your Age Verification," USA Fencing (Zendesk Help Center), https://usafencing.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/29039352416781-How-to-complete-your-Age-Verification, updated 2026-04-03.

These steps are based on project-prepared summaries of public information and are not official USA Fencing policy. For help with account-specific issues, use the official support route provided in the linked article.

Would you like general steps for registering for a tournament or more info about age verification?

results.manualReview: Explicit do-not-upload-documents-in-chat boundary, official portal, source and date present.

results.question: Are local and national tournaments registered in the same place?

messages.text:
Local and national fencing tournaments are not registered in the same place.

Local and divisional events: Registration is done through AskFRED at https://www.askfred.net.
Regional and national events: Registration is handled through the USA Fencing membership portal at https://member.usafencing.org. For regional events, use https://member.usafencing.org/search/tournaments/regional. For national events, use https://member.usafencing.org/search/tournaments/national.

These steps are based on a project-prepared summary of public official-source material, not a USA Fencing-approved document. The main source is "How do I register for a USA Fencing Tournament?" (https://usafencing.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/13085696260749-How-do-I-register-for-a-USA-Fencing-Tournament, source date: 2025-05-09).

Would you like help finding a tournament or more details about the registration process?

results.manualReview: Correct AskFRED/portal distinction and separate labeled regional/national deep links.

results.question: Regional registration is blocked. What can I check?

messages.text:
If regional fencing tournament registration is blocked, here are three common checks based on project-prepared summaries of public USA Fencing sources:

Membership Level: You must have a Competitive membership or an International Competitive License. Access membership alone is not enough for regional events.
Age Verification: Your age must be verified in the USA Fencing membership portal. Unverified age can block event registration. Do not upload identity or age-verification documents in this chat; use the official membership portal.
Age Eligibility: Check if you meet the event’s age requirements.

If you have checked these and still cannot register, contact the regional organizer or email regionalevents@usafencing.org with the tournament name, event, and your membership identifier. Do not send personal identifiers in this chat.

The cited articles are historical guidance. Always confirm current event requirements with the organizer. For details, see:

“Why can't I register for a Regional Tournament?” (https://usafencing.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/29044338279565-Why-can-t-I-register-for-a-Regional-Tournament, updated 2024-08-06)
“How do I register for a USA Fencing Tournament?” (https://usafencing.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/13085696260749-How-do-I-register-for-a-USA-Fencing-Tournament, updated 2025-05-09)

Would you like the direct links for regional or national registration, or help with age verification steps?
